source: PhysioMSKNet bundled data (inst/extdata), digitised from Murphy et al. 2018, PLoS Biology
record_used: the whole-body muscle-bone incidence structure (173 bones as vertices, 270 muscles as hyperedges) built by loadMSKData() + MSKHypergraph(); the impact-vs-cortical-homunculus correspondence data (21 body regions); the muscle-recovery data. All from the published paper.
pipeline: PhysioMSKNet::loadMSKData() -> MSKHypergraph() (the 173x270 muscle-bone hypergraph) -> mskHomuncCorrelation() (regress muscle structural impact against the cortical motor-homunculus map); mskReproducePaper() wraps the full Murphy 2018 reproduction. Deterministic (reference anatomy, no simulation).
note: The bundled data are the paper's own (digitised figures + the reference MSK model), so this validates the ecosystem's hypergraph construction + network/regression machinery against the published result. The impact-homunculus finding (R^2 = 0.517) matches the paper's 0.52; the impact-recovery model reproduces the significant positive direction but a lower R^2 (0.41 vs the paper's 0.76) -- reported in the case note. run_simulation = FALSE (the deterministic structural reproduction; the stochastic control-simulation is out of scope).
